identity.handle_rule: handle_id is derived only from immutable subject identity, subject digest, semantic type, source identity, capture interval, spatial scope, and applied transform
identity.descriptor_rule: availability, retention, capabilities, privacy class, costs, contract basis, and authority anchor are versioned descriptor state and never rebind the handle
identity.collision_rule: one handle_id presented with a different immutable identity is semantic_handle_rebound

levels.meaning: identity, source, bounds, authority, availability, privacy class, level inventory, and priced expansion metadata
typed semantic synopsis, provenance, contradictions, quality, completeness, and omissions
privacy-transformed decision artifact such as a crop, keyframe, trajectory, or graph neighborhood
authorized exact source evidence such as packets, immutable object bytes, or full-resolution media
qualification or explicitly granted debugging expansion

context_expansion_bindings.legacy_slot_rule: ContextItem.expansionHandles and SemanticCompressionReceipt.expansionHandles[].handle in the v1 wire schemas are stable expansion-slot identities, not self-authenticating semantic handles
context_expansion_bindings.reference_rule: every slot is resolved by one SemanticHandleReference binding immutable subject digest, exact descriptor digest, ContractBasis digest, descriptor authority anchor, H-level, and ladder-policy digest
context_expansion_bindings.closure_rule: the ContextExpansionBindingSet must equal the exact union of slots emitted by the ContextPack and SemanticCompressionReceipt; missing, duplicate, and unexpected bindings fail closed
context_expansion_bindings.catalog_rule: the bound publication carries the exact descriptor revisions it uses and rejects both descriptor substitution and unused ambient descriptors
context_expansion_bindings.price_rule: receipt-owned expansion slots repeat the descriptor-owned purpose and complete multidimensional cost exactly; a presentation surface cannot advertise a cheaper or semantically different expansion
context_expansion_bindings.anchor_rule: a descriptor may not come from another site lineage or ledger epoch and may not be newer than the context-pack authority anchor
context_expansion_bindings.handoff_rule: bound publication, binding-set, binding, reference, subject, descriptor, and ladder-policy digests are retained in the handoff child-root set

fallback.direct_request: when allow_lower_level is true, select the richest published lower level satisfying every clamp
fallback.continuation_request: fallback is forbidden; a cursor names one exact next level
fallback.completeness: a lower-level response is partial relative to the requested level
fallback.failure_precedence: the first failure at the requested level is retained when no lower level succeeds

continuation.basis: exact contract basis and descriptor authority anchor
continuation.high_water_mark: one past the maximum published H-level

proof_obligations: exact continuation cursor when richer material remains
context expansion binding-set digest when a context pack exposes expansion slots

unit: immutable handle identity across descriptor revisions
reference: H4 grant denial and qualification success

release_authority: local DSR qualification; hosted workflows are supplementary
